title: Thanksgiving Buffet at Osage Restaurant
seo_title: Thanksgiving Buffet at Osage Restaurant in Ridgedale, MO
description: This Thanksgiving buffet at Osage Restaurant offers holiday favorites, seasonal specialties, and desserts, with views of the Ozarks. Top of the Rock entry is required, and a fee may apply. It runs Thursday, November 26, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM at 150 Top of the Rock in Ridgedale, MO.
address: 150 Top of the Rock, Ridgedale, MO, 65739
